intro: Designed for comfort, our MarshMallow pillow combines soft fabric with supportive firm foam—so every night feels like a retreat, and every morning feels refreshed.

features.title: Only the best, nothing less
features.text: Made from breathable cushion fibre, this pillow provides 3 zone comfort for the side and back sleepers, offering lasting comfort.

features.title: Adaptive support for your neck
features.text: Our adaptive pillow responds to how you sleep, gently adjusting to your position to provide tailored comfort and deeper, more restful sleep.

features.title: Resilient foam for lasting comfort
features.text: Built to prevent sagging over time, our firm base offers lasting support, ensuring your pillow holds its shape and comfort for years.

care: Hand wash in cold water. Do not bleach. Do not tumble dry.
name: Candyfloss Polyster Fiber 17 X 27 Inch Big Pillow
